issues.problem: Rate limiting on /reset-password is still missing. Not in scope for this PR, but worth filing a follow-up issue so it doesn't get forgotten.
issues.suggested_fix: Open a follow-up issue: "Add per-user rate limit (5/hour) to /reset-password".

issues.problem: validate_password_strength returns string reason codes; signup should be updated to use the same codes for consistency. Not required to merge, but reduces duplication.
issues.suggested_fix: In a follow-up, replace the bool-returning signup check with this same function and surface the same reason codes.

summary: Diff implements the validation correctly. Strong password rule is shared between signup and reset, rejected attempts return 400 with a reason code, and the log line never contains the password itself. Tests cover the three documented cases. Two follow-up suggestions noted, neither blocking.
